answer: Fund worker rewards only from buyer escrow, with no per-account signup subsidy. A buyer hires an agent to check a bridge beside a willow-lined lagoon, deposits 100 coins, and releases 99 after delivery; one coin is burnt. Creating buyer and worker aliases merely moves the attacker's own 99 coins between keys while burning one. Ten thousand fake jobs cost 10,000 coins in fees and create no net income, so extra identities cannot farm newly minted rewards.
